kind: Current WXML/WXSS browser source mirrors. Synthetic display fixtures. Not WeChat simulator/device. Selected routes and applicable branches at 320/390; default covers every registered route.
limitations: Source layout mirror with synthetic fixtures; no lifecycle/API/device interaction
Native pickers, textareas, scroll areas and custom header are approximated in browser
Contact sheets crop the top of each page; individual PNGs show the complete rendered page
